title: Air Fryer Beefy Vegan Taquitos
description: These air fryer vegan taquitos are made with vegan ground beef, vegan cream cheese, nutritional yeast, and corn tortillas.
ingredients: 1 (12 ounce) package vegetarian ground beef crumbles (such as MorningStar Farms®), thawed
2 canned chipotle chilies in adobo sauce, minced
2 tablespoons adobo sauce from chipotle peppers
0.5 (8 ounce) tub vegan cream cheese (such as Toffutti®)

steps.text: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook for 3 minutes. Add vegetarian beef crumbles, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, cumin, and onion powder. Cook and stir for 5 minutes.
Add cream cheese, nutritional yeast, and salt. Cook until cheese is melted and everything is evenly combined, about 2 minutes. Remove from heat.
Preheat an air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).

Spoon a heaping tablespoon of mixture into the middle of each tortilla and roll up. Working in batches, place a single layer of taquitos in the air fryer basket, seam-side down. Spray the tops with cooking spray. Air fry for 6 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate. Repeat with remaining taquitos.
